title: Huntington Museum of Art
geometryBasis: Combined building footprint and inner court, individually named conservatory point, and two exact public-domain Qualla photographs of the museum entrance and conservatory together.
sectionBasis: Low red brick galleries and light squared stone pilasters surround the entry drive. The projecting stone entrance sits beside the glass-walled conservatory with metal sloping bays and a higher glazed clerestory.
limitations: The mapped gallery envelope, open courtyard and connected conservatory are represented. Rear façade heights and openings are approximate.
The geometry focuses on the buildings and entry structure. Freestanding art and detached studios are outside scope.
